Exercise A

Simple or continuous?

Use the past continuous for the background, an action in progress. Use the past simple for the main events and for a short action that interrupts. Choose the correct form for each gap.

Before you start — optional, not marked
This is just to get you thinking. You can leave it empty and it does not count towards your score.
